sample_unit: clinical cases (UCI Heart Disease dataset; 1,200 total predictions)

links.outcome: Output reproducibility across repeated runs and prompt-variation sensitivity
links.effect: Intra-model consistency 99-100% (Qwen-Plus 100%); prompt variation changed <=3% of predictions; inter-model agreement 98-99%.
links.quote: All models achieved exceptional intra-model consistency (99-100%), with Qwen-Plus demonstrating perfect reproducibility (100%).

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of general-purpose LLMs on heart disease cases despite high exam scores
links.effect: Diagnostic accuracy about 50%, equivalent to random guessing, despite 60-80% on licensing exams; consistency-accuracy gap of about 50 percentage points.
links.quote: However, diagnostic accuracy remained at approximately 50%, equivalent to random guessing.

screen.reason: Evaluates consistency and accuracy of frontier LLMs on a diagnostic benchmark dataset (UCI Heart Disease) without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
